# Introducing ICeGaN® Technology

[Industry-First, Easy to Use e-Mode GaN][Industry-First, Easy to Use e-Mode GaN]
Industry-First, Easy to Use e-Mode GaN

Integrated Circuit Enhancement Mode GaN: a novel platform with state-of-the-art static and dynamic
performance increased ease-of-use and intelligent temperature control for the internal gate terminal
for enhanced gate reliability. Unlike other existing GaN devices, our smart ICeGaN® transistor can
be operated with standard silicon gate drivers and does not require negative voltages for shutdown,
hence removing the need for external, costly driving and clamping interfaces. Finally, a GaN power
transistor that can be operated like a MOSFET.

[read more][13]
[> 50% Energy Saved][> 50% Energy Saved]
> 50% Energy Saved

As electrification advances worldwide, so does the demand for highly efficient and innovative
solutions. ICeGaN® power devices can operate at much higher switching frequency with lower losses
and lower on-resistance than state-of-the-art silicon devices, delivering higher performance while
increasing energy savings by as much as 50%.

[read more][14]
[> 2x Smaller Electronics][> 2x Smaller Electronics]
> 2x Smaller Electronics

GaN transistors make it easy to operate many power topologies at a much higher frequency while still
achieving extremely high energy efficiency, thus enabling many applications to become smaller and
lighter. CGD's ICeGaN® integrates several features into their enhancement-mode GaN transistor to run
cooler and more reliably than ever before, hence complementing the obvious advantage of GaN vs
Silicon in achieving unprecedented power density.

[read more][15]

# Latest News

This new long-term collaboration will enable NXP to develop GaN-based system solutions, leveraging
CGD’s advanced GaN products, early access to next-generation CGD GaN developments, and the team’s
extensive expertise in GaN processes and technologies.

][16][

#### **New 650 V ICeGaN Device for Automotive Applications From CGD Helps Increase EV Range**

CGD's new 650V ICeGaN® device with low on-resistance improves inverter efficiency for reduced
thermal management provision and enables higher frequency switching for system size and weight
reduction.

][17][

#### **New CEO Appointed at Cambridge GaN Devices**

Cambridge GaN Devices announced the appointment of Fabio Necco as Chief Executive Officer. The move
is designed to drive forward CGD’s entry into key markets.

Digi’s solution was flexible enough to take the data and send it real-time to our cloud environment.
Digi also showed it could scale up to support our global footprint.

Ezhil Nanjappan, Otis Elevator Director of IoT and Mobility Solutions

Digi

We tried to create our own FCC-licensed radio product, but it was a big drain on our engineering
resources, and we weren’t totally happy with the performance. Digi's robustness was far better than
the other alternatives we evaluated.

Jacob Christfort, Founder

Digi

Digi hardened rail routers provide fault-tolerant and failsafe communications, both on-board and
with remote systems over cellular networks.

Digi

Digi TX64 is the ideal choice for TriMet, because of its durability, performance, and
customizability. We love that we can customize the router through Digi Advanced Linux and custom
Python apps to integrate it easily with our CAD/AVL, and other vehicle-based systems.

Evan Yand, Senior Vehicle Systems Engineer

Digi

We are integrating Digi technology into a range of solutions, including smart irrigation systems, to
help modern farms deploy remote sensors, cameras, and wireless networks for greater efficiency in
the fields.

Troy Long, Vice President Technology Value Stream

enterprise operations everywhere. Digi unifies its brands, innovations, and global expertise into a
single mission: to help the world build smarter, connect securely, and manage confidently.

Industrial IoT, cloud computing, IoT integration, and edge computing

### Need remote walk-in cooler temperature monitoring?

automated compliance reporting to protect food safety and prevent spoilage.

[SmartSense Voyage][205]

### Struggling with deployments?

Digi’s SOC 2 Type II secure edge technology, connectivity solutions, and centralized management
capabilities simplify deployments and scale enterprise networks.

[Digi Cellular Routers Edge Computing][206]

### Replace fragile serial cabling with network infrastructure?

Digi Connect EZ device servers — bringing RS-232/485 equipment onto secure Ethernet or cellular
networks for reliable remote access and easier scalability.

[Digi Connect EZ][207]

Digi XBee modules support a wide range of RF protocols, and come pre-certified and well-documented
with integration guidance to build quickly and focus testing on the end product.

[Digi XBee][208]

Opengear Lighthouse, a SOC 2 Type II compliant, centralized OOB console access with LTE failover,
alerting, remote power control, plus secure access control and policy enforcement.

[Opengear Lighthouse][209]

### A fully managed connectivity provider for remote sites?

Digi Ventus delivers fully managed connectivity for remote sites with 24/7 monitoring, carrier
management, secure access, and failover.

[Digi Managed Connectivity Platform][210]

# Automation without perfection: How intelligent robots can handle HMLV manufacturing

## Traditional automation performs best in a highly organised environment. Products must always
## arrive in the same position, production lines need to maintain a fixed rhythm, and individual

## product changes, component shortages and unpredictable order schedules can make a factory
## resemble a living organism rather than a precisely calibrated machine. Speaking at Evertiq Expo

## artificial intelligence could make robots better suited to this complex environment.

[
[1Silicon Nitride Wafer]

Glass wafer

Glass wafers are round glass sheets processed from glass materials. They are usually made of
different types of glass, quartz, alkali-free glass and glass-silicon composite materials, and are
used in the semiconductor and microelectronics industries. Glass wafers have high chemical
resistance and thermal stability, low surface roughness, high transmittance, etc. These
characteristics make them widely used.
[jxjf-case-more]

Silicon Nitride Wafer

Silicon nitride (Si3N4) wafers are a key material in a variety of high-tech applications due to
their unique properties. These wafers are primarily used in the semiconductor industry, but their
applications extend far beyond that, making them a versatile choice for numerous technological
advancements.
[jxjf-case-more]
][237]
[
[3Silicon Nitride Wafer]

Silicon Oxide Wafer

Silicon oxide wafers, also known as silicon dioxide wafers, are an integral component in the
semiconductor industry and a variety of technological applications. Their unique properties make
them essential for a wide range of uses, from microelectronics to optics. This article takes an
in-depth look at the applications of silicon oxide wafers, highlighting their importance in modern
technology.

Silicon wafer

A wafer is a round silicon chip and is also the carrier used to produce integrated circuits. It can
be processed into integrated circuit products with various circuit component structures and specific
electrical functions.

Glass wafers are round glass sheets processed from glass materials. They are usually made of
different types of glass, quartz, alkali-free glass and glass-silicon composite materials, and are
used in the semiconductor and microelectronics industries. Glass wafers have high chemical
resistance and thermal stability, low surface roughness, high transmittance, etc. These
characteristics make them widely used.

WHY CHOOSE US

## We Provide Quality Not Quantity

Just like cosmetics have the magical power to make people beautiful, the precision polishing
materials developed by Grish also have the ability to improve the surface accuracy and aesthetics of
various high-precision parts. Because of this, Grish products have a huge customer group and are
deeply loved by the market.
* ### Fully Experienced
  
  With more than 20 years engaging in ultra-fine polishing abrasive material, we accumulated a bunch
  of customer cases, so we can help you customize polishing solutions more comprehensively and
  meticulously, to optimize your processes and improve your efficient.
* ### Strong R&D Ability
  
  In-depth cooperation with universities for more than 20 years, keeping up with cutting-edge
  technologies, has transformed a number of scientific projects into results. Holds 49 domestic and
  foreign invention patents, and participates in the editor-in-chief of 5 industry standards.
* ### Professional Service Team
  
  Our sales and service team are trained for at least 3 months to get deep understanding our clients
  group, then offer you constructive suggestions for your polishing processes. If you encounter any
  problems during cooperation, our team is at your service around the clock.
* ### Consistent Products Quality
  
  Strictly abide by ISO9001, command quality from human, machine, material, law, environment, etc.,
  to ensure the uniform and qualified quality of products. Multi-party organizations participate in
  the inspection, and strive to produce perfect products, in order to play their greatest role.
* ### Stable & Controllable Lead Time
  
  12000-square-meters factory, with high-end imported production equipment and more than 100
  production technicians, more than half of whom have worked for 5-10 years, to ensure that orders
  are completed on time and products are delivered in time.
* ### Open and Win-win Cooperation
  
  Our core values are “people-oriented, customer first, integrity and pragmatism, unity and
  progress, and pursuit of excellence”. We strive to create more value in the polishing field and
  realize the coordinated development of employees, enterprises, customers and society.

OUR PRODUCTS

## Our Main Products
* Lapping Film

* Polishing Powder

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### **Q: How does a managed service provider actually save my business money?**

A: Most businesses are overpaying for internet without realizing it. We recently helped a business
paying for multiple separate ISP connections, one for cameras, one for the office, one for phones,
one for guests. They only needed one. We replaced all of it with a single internet source and built
separate secure networks within it using VLANs. Guest Wi-Fi, cameras, VoIP phones, office computers,
and printers all run on the same connection but completely isolated from each other. The result was
hundreds of dollars saved every single month. One bill. One network. Everything working together. 👉
[Read more in our article: Stop Letting Your Internet Be Lazy][29]

#### **Q: What does Interstate Telecommunications actually do?**

A: We are a managed services provider focused on the five systems every modern business depends on:
Wi-Fi, IP security cameras, VoIP phone systems, access control, and structured cabling. We design,
install, and support all of it. Then our 24/7 U.S.-based customer support team keeps it running long
after installation. We help businesses better utilize their technology, make it more efficient, and
save money in the process. 👉 [Read more in our article: 7 Benefits To Hiring a Managed Service
Provider][30]

#### **Q: What happens when something stops working at my business?**

A: That is exactly what our 24/7 customer support team is for. When your internet goes down, a
camera stops recording, or your phones go offline, a real person answers the phone and works to get
everything back online, often before you even notice there is a problem. No waiting on hold with an
ISP. No sending staff to reboot routers. We handle it around the clock, every day of the year. 👉
[Read more in our article: 24/7 Support: How Our Team Keeps You Connected][31]

#### **Q: How is Interstate Telecommunications different from other managed service providers?**

A: We have been in the managed services space since 1991. What sets us apart is our 24/7 U.S.-based
customer support team and our commitment to staying long after installation. We do not just fix
problems. We partner with businesses to make sure their technology is working efficiently and doing
more for them every day. We own the outcome for as long as you are our customer. 👉 [Read more in
our article: 7 Benefits To Hiring a Managed Service Provider][32]

  and point-to-multipoint wireless bridges, cellular signal enhancement with repeaters and DAS
  systems, and IoT-ready networking for smart devices and sensors.
  
  From initial site surveys and network design to professional installation and ongoing support, we
  ensure your wireless infrastructure is fast, reliable, and built to grow with your business.
  
  CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO
* ### VoIP Phone Systems for Business
  
  Clear, reliable communication is essential for every business. Our VoIP phone solutions range from
  simple hosted systems to full enterprise-grade deployments designed for scalability, redundancy,
  and advanced call handling.
  
  We deliver feature-rich VoIP platforms with auto attendants, call routing, voicemail to email,
  mobile apps, and analytics, along with specialized solutions including emergency 911 compliant
  phones, long-range cordless systems, cellular-enabled voice failover, and both coin and cashless
  payphone services.
  
  From design and deployment to ongoing support and management, we ensure your phone system works
  seamlessly across offices, remote staff, and mission-critical environments.
  
  [**CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO**][27]
* ### Structured Cabling & Network Installation
  
  Need reliable network wiring for your business? We design and install complete network
  infrastructure and low-voltage cabling for offices, warehouses, campuses, medical facilities, and
  multi-building sites.
  
  Our team handles **structured cabling** from end to end, including **Cat6/Cat6A Ethernet cable
  runs**, **network drops**, **patch panels**, **server racks**, **MDF/IDF buildouts**, and clean,
  labeled cable management. We also install and terminate **fiber optic cabling** (single-mode and
  multi-mode) for high-speed backbones, long-distance links, and building-to-building connectivity,
  plus **coax** and other low-voltage systems as needed.
  
  Whether you are adding a few Ethernet ports or building a full network from the ground up, we
  deliver a professional installation that is standards-based, documented, and built to scale.
* ### Access Control & Door Entry Solutions
  
  Control who can enter your building and when. We design, install, and support commercial access
  control systems for offices, campuses, warehouses, healthcare facilities, and gated properties.
  
  Our access control solutions support key fobs, RFID cards, NFC mobile credentials, PIN codes,
  license plate recognition, and facial recognition, allowing you to manage doors, gates, and secure
  areas from a centralized platform. Access permissions can be assigned by user, location, or
  schedule, making it easy to grant, restrict, or revoke access at any time.
  
  From single-door systems to multi-site deployments, we provide professional installation, secure
  configuration, and ongoing support to ensure your access control system is reliable, scalable, and
  easy to manage.
* ### IP Cameras & Video Surveillance
  
  Protect your property, employees, and customers with professional IP security camera systems
  designed for reliability, clarity, and intelligent monitoring. We design, install, and support
  commercial video surveillance systems for businesses, campuses, medical facilities, and multi-site
  environments.
  
  Our solutions include high-definition IP cameras, secure network video recorders (NVRs), and
  scalable storage options with motion recording, AI-powered person and vehicle detection, license
  plate recognition, two-way audio, and remote viewing from desktop or mobile devices. Indoor and
  outdoor cameras are available, with options for night vision, wide-angle coverage, and long-term
  video retention.
  
  From camera placement and network design to power, storage, and ongoing support, we handle every
  aspect of your video surveillance system to ensure dependable performance and easy access when it
  matters most.
* ### Managed Services & 24/7 Customer Support
  
  Technology should support your business, not slow it down or leave you scrambling when something
  breaks. Our managed services are designed to fit your operation, not force you into an
  all-or-nothing support model.
  
  What sets us apart is our **24/7/365 **customer support team. When there is an issue, your staff
  and guests speak directly with a real person who knows your systems and works to resolve problems
  quickly. You do not field the calls. You do not troubleshoot. We handle it.
  
  Our support options are flexible, scalable, and built around your environment, budget, and
  business goals, so you get exactly the level of coverage you need without paying for what you do
  not.

[ Learn More About Our Services ][28]

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### **Q: How does a managed service provider actually save my business money?**

A: Most businesses are overpaying for internet without realizing it. We recently helped a business
paying for multiple separate ISP connections, one for cameras, one for the office, one for phones,
one for guests. They only needed one. We replaced all of it with a single internet source and built
separate secure networks within it using VLANs. Guest Wi-Fi, cameras, VoIP phones, office computers,
and printers all run on the same connection but completely isolated from each other. The result was
hundreds of dollars saved every single month. One bill. One network. Everything working together. 👉
[Read more in our article: Stop Letting Your Internet Be Lazy][29]

#### **Q: What does Interstate Telecommunications actually do?**

A: We are a managed services provider focused on the five systems every modern business depends on:
Wi-Fi, IP security cameras, VoIP phone systems, access control, and structured cabling. We design,
install, and support all of it. Then our 24/7 U.S.-based customer support team keeps it running long
after installation. We help businesses better utilize their technology, make it more efficient, and
save money in the process. 👉 [Read more in our article: 7 Benefits To Hiring a Managed Service
Provider][30]

#### **Q: What happens when something stops working at my business?**

A: That is exactly what our 24/7 customer support team is for. When your internet goes down, a
camera stops recording, or your phones go offline, a real person answers the phone and works to get
everything back online, often before you even notice there is a problem. No waiting on hold with an
ISP. No sending staff to reboot routers. We handle it around the clock, every day of the year. 👉
[Read more in our article: 24/7 Support: How Our Team Keeps You Connected][31]

#### **Q: How is Interstate Telecommunications different from other managed service providers?**

A: We have been in the managed services space since 1991. What sets us apart is our 24/7 U.S.-based
customer support team and our commitment to staying long after installation. We do not just fix
problems. We partner with businesses to make sure their technology is working efficiently and doing
more for them every day. We own the outcome for as long as you are our customer. 👉 [Read more in
our article: 7 Benefits To Hiring a Managed Service Provider][32]

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

##### **¿QUE ES LA [INSTRUMENTACIÓN][66]?**


Es aquella que abarca un conjunto de elementos con los cuales se pueden medir, procesar, registrar
y/o convertir variables físico-químicas para que por medio de ellas se puedan optimizar y controlar
procesos industriales.

La instrumentación[nstrumentación][67] no solo está en la industria sino también en la medicina, en
la aeronáutica, en la electrónica y en otras bases del conocimiento.

###### **¿QUE ES EL [CONTROL][68]?**


Es un área de la ingeniería que se encarga del control de un proceso en una condición determinada;
Un ejemplo claro de ello puede ser, mantener la temperatura de un sistema de calefacción, la
trayectoria realizada por un avión o la velocidad de un móvil en un valor establecido.

El [control industrial,][69] también denominada teoría de control, se encarga de estudiar el
comportamiento de los sistemas dinámicos, definiéndolos como «bloques» con una entrada y una salida.

Generalmente, la entrada al sistema es una señal  de tipo análoga o digital que se detecta en algún
punto del sistema.

Los bloques intercalados en un sistema completo, representan las  acciones  que afectan a la señal,
como la fricción en los actuadores, así como el efecto de los elementos de control interpuestos, los
reguladores.

**¿QUE ES LA [INGENIERÍA ELECTRÓNICA][70]?**


la ingeniería electrónica se integra de manera natural con las tareas cotidianas de la sociedad: Se
busca la optimización de la producción industrial por medio de la producción de algoritmos para el
control y automatización de procesos; suministra recursos para el monitoreo e instrumentación para
variables físicas; entrega técnicas para dotar de interconectividad a procesos de comunicación
humana e incluso entre máquinas; investiga en algoritmos de aprendizaje automático; afecta
positivamente la manera en la cual se realizan los procedimientos médicos proveyendo equipos
biomédicos; entre otras muchas aplicaciones. La electrónica es transversal a prácticamente a
cualquier disciplina del conocimiento.

 

**¿QUE ES LA MECATRÓNICA?**


La ingeniería mecatrónica es una disciplina interdisciplinaria que combina elementos de la mecánica,
electrónica, control y computación para desarrollar sistemas avanzados y sofisticados.

Se trata de una rama de la ingeniería que busca integrar diferentes componentes y sistemas en una
sola unidad, para crear sistemas más eficientes y efectivos.

La ingeniería mecatrónica se utiliza en una amplia gama de aplicaciones, desde robots industriales y
sistemas de automatización hasta vehículos autónomos y sistemas aeroespaciales.

Se enfoca en el diseño, la fabricación, el control y la mantenimiento de sistemas mecatrónicos
complejos.

En resumen, la ingeniería mecatrónica es una combinación de habilidades técnicas y conocimientos
interdisciplinarios que se utilizan para desarrollar soluciones innovadoras en el campo de la
tecnología y la automatización.

electrónica, control y computación para desarrollar sistemas avanzados y sofisticados.

Se trata de una rama de la ingeniería que busca integrar diferentes componentes y sistemas en una
sola unidad, para crear sistemas más eficientes y efectivos.

La ingeniería mecatrónica se utiliza en una amplia gama de aplicaciones, desde robots industriales y
sistemas de automatización hasta vehículos autónomos y sistemas aeroespaciales.

Se enfoca en el diseño, la fabricación, el control y la mantenimiento de sistemas mecatrónicos
complejos.

En resumen, la ingeniería mecatrónica es una combinación de habilidades técnicas y conocimientos
interdisciplinarios que se utilizan para desarrollar soluciones innovadoras en el campo de la
tecnología y la automatización.
